facts: About 20,000 people in the urban area (2013)
Built on reclaimed land, on a flood plain
worth_knowing: Its sheltered harbour receives cargo vessels, ferries and cruise ships. Two Nobel winners were born here: Arthur Lewis (Economics, 1979) and Derek Walcott (Literature, 1992).
